verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs describe connecting initiatives across teams, prioritizing work, cultivating ownership, and customizable fields and workflows that could carry status and priority. However, no evidence shows a dedicated initiative object with explicit status, priority, and owning-team fields, and one user calls high-level planning in Jira frustrating. missing for 10: explicit documentation of initiative-level status, priority, and owning-team fields; hands-on corroboration of initiative tracking.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
Prioritize high-impact work, break down big projects into clear tasks, and cultivate ownership.
Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
